newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City Stores holders ok stock plan.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City Stores holders ok stock plan.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc said Friday its shareholders approved a plan to create two series of common stock for the its consumer electronics and appliance business and its CarMax auto retailing business.
The company said under the plan its board will designate 125 million common shares for its Circuit City Group and 125 million common shares for its CarMax Group.
Each outstanding share of the company's common stock will be redesignated as one share of Circuit City Group Stock, the company said.

The company said its shareholders also approved three related proposals that allow it to proceed with the CarMax Group public offering of stock representing about 20 percent of the group's equity value.
